# Zoopy

> Zoopy watches Facebook Marketplace for you and sends a push alert when a new listing matches your hunt, with the price, the distance and a deal verdict.

Zoopy is a phone app (private beta on iPhone; Android next; not yet in the App Store or Google Play). Users make "hunts" (a car, an iPhone or any keywords; a price range; any place in the world plus a radius up to 500 km). Zoopy's servers check Facebook Marketplace's public listings around the clock and send a push alert when a new listing matches. It reads the full listing before alerting. It needs no Facebook login and never posts or messages for the user. Pro and Max hunts can also watch AutoTrader Australia (dealer cars) and Kijiji (Canada).

Facts:
- Facebook keeps a new listing out of public search for about six to seven minutes after posting, for everyone. In Zoopy's September 2026 tests on car listings around Brisbane, Australia, the typical alert went out about 6.5 minutes after the seller posted.
- Paces per hunt: Turbo (Max; targets a check about every 15 seconds), and targets of every 3 minutes (Pro, Max), 5 and 10 minutes (all plans). Paces are targets.
- Plans (Australian dollars a month; 3 and 6-month terms cost less per month; 7-day free trial on monthly plans for new subscribers): Go A$36.99 with 10 hunts; Pro A$114.99 with 21 hunts; Max A$279.99 with 24 hunts.
- Zoopy is independent and not affiliated with Meta Platforms, Inc. Contact: zoopy.ops@gmail.com.
